reason: The deterministic mentor planner and claim-safety architecture are promising and independently verified, but the product acceptance gate is incomplete: the player-facing Critique flow deliberately refuses to use Judge 2 when Judge 1 passes because no frozen same-state Judge 2 evidence is integrated, and the review package contains browser acceptance but no screenshot evidence for the Alya Mentor UI. Alya Mentor cannot be approved while its central visual-critique pathway is intentionally unavailable in the actual interaction flow.
required_changes: Integrate the existing frozen same-state Judge 2 evidence path into Alya Mentor so a Judge 1 PASS submission can receive evidence-backed perceptual critique without fabricating or stale-matching Judge 2 results.
Bind MentorEvidenceBundle to exact state provenance and exact Judge 2 capture provenance; fail closed on mismatch.
Preserve the current rule that Alya never guesses visual consequence when matching Judge 2 evidence is unavailable.

Add browser acceptance for the actual player-facing flow: hint progression, Judge 1 technical critique, Judge 2 perceptual critique after a matching capture, Why expansion, and no state mutation from mentor actions.

Publish clean screenshots of the Alya Mentor panel in at least: observe/default, hint, technical critique, perceptual critique, and Why-expanded states. Keep screenshots separate from measured Judge 2 capture pixels.
Add adversarial tests for stale Judge 2 evidence, wrong state provenance, wrong viewpoint/profile provenance, and low-confidence wording so unsupported visual claims cannot leak into feedback.
Keep the deterministic planner as authority. Do not add an LLM/cloud dependency in this correction.
Keep Judge 1, Judge 2, fixed exposure, simulation state, and renderer behavior unchanged unless a minimal adapter is strictly required for provenance-safe handoff.
protected_aspects: Preserve Teach, Hint, Critique, and Challenge role architecture and progressive hint depth.
Preserve confidence-aware language and explicit limitations.
Preserve the prohibition on invented lux, UGR, standards claims, hidden metrics, and automatic design mutation.
Do not start the next product phase, merge branches, self-approve, or touch Pulla Reddy.
